mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, password_hash, nickname, profile_image_url, selected_coach_id, status, onboarding_completed ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{profileImageUrl}, #{selectedCoachId}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'), COALESCE(#{onboardingCompleted}, FALSE) )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, email, password_hash, nickname, profile_image_url, selected_coach_id, status, onboarding_completed, created_at, updated_at, deactivated_at FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id, email, password_hash, nickname, profile_image_url, selected_coach_id, status, onboarding_completed, created_at, updated_at, deactivated_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY user_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = CONCAT('deleted-', user_id, '-', REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), '@invalid.local'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'INACTIVE'
UPDATE users SET nickname = #{nickname}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET profile_image_url = #{profileImageUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET profile_image_url = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET selected_coach_id = #{selectedCoachId}, onboarding_completed = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE users SET email = CONCAT('deleted-', user_id, '-', REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), '@invalid.local'), status = 'INACTIVE', deactivated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
